title: Reject plans citing nonexistent paths unless declared as newFiles
description: Objective: submit_plan rejects plans whose affectedFiles cite paths that do not exist on disk, unless the step declares them in a new step.newFiles[] field — catching stale-doc plan defects at submit time instead of step 1. Deliverable: newFiles in the step schema + existence check in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/submitPlan.ts with a teaching error message. NOT in scope: content validation of the files. DEPENDS on task order 1 landing first (same file: submitPlan.ts — do not work these in parallel). Spec: item #2 in tag archive/governance-plane-v2. Verification command: npx vitest run src/tools/submitPlan.test.ts
definitionOfDone: A plan citing only existing paths passes unchanged
A plan citing a missing path without declaring it in step.newFiles is rejected with an error naming the path and the fix
The same plan with the path declared in step.newFiles passes, and newFiles survive into the persisted implementationPlan
Plan-size gate and rails checks are unaffected (existing submitPlan tests stay green)
